column1: # Manually curated familiar phrases and reasonable next-word alternatives; not extracted
# from a prediction index and not inferred from handset input or private user histories.
# This measures exact top-5 coverage of these known continuations, not user intent accuracy.
# Freeze this file before evaluating or tuning. Development = every fifth item (40 rows);
# heldout = the other four (160 rows). Never move failures between splits or drop them.
# Alternatives are acceptable continuations, not an exhaustive semantic correctness label.
# Forbidden values explicitly identify a few boundary-truncation regressions only. Other
# unmatched suggestions are unlabelled, so they must not be counted as unrelated or wrong.
# Password/private-editor exclusion is a separate runtime test, not a text-corpus metric.
# Columns: id, split, category, context, acceptable continuations (|), forbidden continuations (|).
